map.输入绣花面积、针距与线密度，计算绣花针数与用线量: Input embroidery area, stitch pitch and thread density to compute stitch count and thread usage
map.💡 针数 = 面积 × 线密度；用线量 = 针数 × 针距: 💡 Stitch count = area × thread density; thread usage = stitch count × pitch
map.针距越小、线密度越高，绣花越密实但用线越多: Smaller pitch and higher thread density make embroidery denser but use more thread
map.实际用线量需加 5%～10% 余量（打结、换色损耗）: Actual thread needs 5%-10% allowance (knots, color changes)
map.验布时数经密、纬密，判断是否符合规格: Count warp/weft density on inspection to verify spec compliance
map.密度异常导致克重/手感偏差时定位纱支或织机问题: When density anomaly causes GSM/feel deviation, locate yarn or loom issues
map.不同组织密度对比，估手感与透气性: Compare densities of different weaves to estimate feel and breathability
map.5 cm × 5 cm 样内数得横密 150 针、纵密 140 针 → 经密 =: In a 5×5 cm swatch, 150 horizontal and 140 vertical stitches → warp 150/5 = 30 /cm, weft 140/5 = 28 /cm (i.e. 300×280 /10cm).
map.经密 30 根/cm + 纬密 28 根/cm = 58 根/cm，总紧度随纱支: Warp 30 /cm + weft 28 /cm = 58 /cm; total cover factor varies with yarn and weave.
map.密度怎么数最准？: How to count density most accurately?
map.用密度镜数 5 cm 内根数再换算到 10 cm，避边缘取中间代表性区域。: Use a pick glass to count within 5 cm then convert to 10 cm; avoid edges, take representative middle area.
map.不一定，高密度更厚实但可能偏硬、透气差；按用途平衡（如夏布宜稀、工装宜密）。: Not necessarily; high density is thicker but may be stiff and less breathable; balance by use (e.g. summer cloth sparse, workwear dense).
map.绣花针数与用线量决定绣花的密实度与成本。本工具根据绣花面积、针距与线密度，计算总: Embroidery stitch count and thread usage determine density and cost. This tool computes total stitches, theoretical and loss-inclusive thread usage from area, pitch and thread density, aiding embroidery parameter setting and thread purchasing.
map.总针数与用线量同步计算: Total stitches and thread usage computed together
map.支持自定义针距与线密度: Supports custom pitch and thread density
